name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Self-hosted Convex reactive backend with its admin dashboard, storing documents in a bundled PostgreSQL 17 database instead of SQLite.

alerts.message: The dashboard asks for an admin key. After the first start, open a terminal in the convex-backend container and run ./generate_admin_key.sh, then use that key on the dashboard login and as CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY (with CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL set to the api. subdomain) in your project.
